recovery: At common exact physical XYZ points, inverse-map each containing faceted stdBrick; compute strain directly from saved displacement gradient and the same isotropic elastic constitutive law. Not extrapolation of Gauss stresses. On shared faces retain every one-sided value, min/max and arithmetic mean. No across-element smoothing field or surface extrapolation.
local_axes: s follows profile continuously from LH base up over crown down to RH base; y=global +Y; n=s cross y outward. Wall LH s=+Z,n=-X; wall RH s=-Z,n=+X. Curved axes follow exact physical radial normal, not facet normal.
stress_units: kPa; tension positive; physical shear stress (not engineering shear strain)

qa_declared_before_postprocessing.timing: Declared before reading the new local-field diagnostic; original S2D FEM runs already exist. These are diagnostic criteria, not retroactive S2D approval or code checks.
qa_declared_before_postprocessing.group_acceptance: All six components must meet point change, component RMS change and finest one-sided spread in each predeclared group. Sampled groups do not establish convergence everywhere, even when they meet these targets.

limitations: Only S2D t175/F-R limit/linear-uncracked/SW+roof LL; no material or thickness selection
No stress sampling at concrete faces, exact support edge, Uy datum, or exact crown joint
Stress grid is diagnostic, not a peak envelope or design force set
Nodal loads and support idealization can affect local stresses; equilibrium does not remove discretization error
No code strength/crack/deflection approval or reinforcement/joint design
